Reliance Industries announced a sharp rise in its second‑quarter profit, with one report citing a 33% jump to Rs 29,550 crore and another noting a 41% increase to Rs 25,548 crore, driven by strong telecom and petrochemical performance.

Investors are closely monitoring a slate of stocks highlighted by Moneycontrol, including Reliance, Maruti Suzuki, EAAA, NTPC, Affle, KIMS, NCC, Jio Platforms and Coal India.

Additional names such as Mahindra & Mahindra, CDSL, ITC, IOCL and Hero MotoCorp also featured in the day's news, reflecting broad market interest across sectors.
